nodes.name: Send WhatsApp
nodes.notes: Disabled on import so a first run cannot message real people. Point WHATSAPP_API_URL / WHATSAPP_TOKEN at the Meta Cloud API (or swap this for a Twilio node), then enable. `neverError` is on so one bad number does not abort the batch — the aggregator counts it as failed.
